scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-neurasticity-rules "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:repositories: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-nfct-repositories "vitest run --config vitest.repositories.config.ts"
scripts.test:functions: npm run functions:build && npm run test:functions:core && npm run test:functions:triggers
scripts.test:functions:core: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-nfct-functions-core "vitest run --config functions/vitest.config.mts test/core"
scripts.test:functions:triggers: firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore --project demo-nfct-functions "vitest run --config functions/vitest.config.mts test/triggers"
scripts.test:e2e:protocol: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-neurasticity-protocol-e2e "playwright test --config playwright.protocol.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:webkit: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-neurasticity-protocol-e2e "playwright test --config playwright.webkit.config.ts"
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npm run verify:ios-release
scripts.sync:ios:emulators: NODE_ENV=development VITE_E2E_EMULATORS=true VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-neurasticity-protocol-e2e VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=local-test-key vite build --mode development && npx cap sync ios && echo 'Synced an emulator bundle for Debug builds only; Release builds refuse it.'
